scripts.install:all: pnpm -C standard-ecommerce install && pnpm -C react-deferred-hydration install && pnpm -C ts-deferred-hydration install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --restart-tries 0 --names "standard,react,ts" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "pnpm -C standard-ecommerce dev" "pnpm -C react-deferred-hydration dev" "pnpm -C ts-deferred-hydration dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C standard-ecommerce build && pnpm -C react-deferred-hydration build && pnpm -C ts-deferred-hydration build
